verdict.rationale: Expensify documents an Integration Server API with partner credentials and an OAuth2 flow, so the API axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence describes API versioning or a deprecation policy. The only lifecycle-adjacent note is that regenerating a client secret immediately invalidates the old one, which is credential rotation, not API versioning or deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
